I be old man now, 66 years, and this small plot of sorghum na only 0.08 hectare, so I no fit spend plenty money on am. Fertilizer dey costly and subsidy no dey reach us proper for village, but I go try buy small NPK and urea if I fit, because the soil here for North West don tire. I go use the local sorghum seed wey I save from last harvest — e sabi our dry weather pass this hybrid ones. Rain na my only water, no irrigation for this side, and me and my family go do most of the work ourselves; maybe I go call one or two young men for weeding time.
